single_scenario.reason: THESIS_INVALIDATED is cooldown-exempt — always alerts immediately.

notes: This scenario sets context['invalidation_triggered'] = true (an upstream, live-data judgment call that Bitmomo_Watchtower_State_Transition_Engine explicitly does not make itself — see its docblock) to demonstrate THESIS_INVALIDATED. Note THESIS_INVALIDATED is checked at priority step 3, BEFORE the regime/bias diff check — so even though this scenario's new_thesis also differs in regime and bias from the previous one (which would independently trigger THESIS_CHANGE), invalidation_triggered wins by priority order and the result is THESIS_INVALIDATED, not THESIS_CHANGE.

alert_scenarios.single_scenario uses a last_alert_at_for_class only 15 minutes before 'now' — inside the 60-minute cooldown window — yet should_alert is still true, because THESIS_INVALIDATED maps to ALERT_CLASS_THESIS_INVALIDATED, which is in Bitmomo_Watchtower_Alert_Policy::COOLDOWN_EXEMPT_ALERT_CLASSES. This is the concrete demonstration of Task 7's 'invalidation during cooldown' requirement: invalidation alerts are never suppressed by cooldown, unlike the OPEN_INTEREST_SHOCK fixture's MATERIAL_CHANGE alert.
